description: Fetch a job posting by ReliefWeb numeric ID with the full vacancy description, application instructions, dates, hiring organization, and location and taxonomy metadata. Use after reliefweb_search_jobs, which returns summaries without the description or application instructions. Reaches expired postings as well as open ones. A record over the response budget comes back as a section outline naming every section and its byte size; re-call with sections to pull only the ones needed. Nothing is truncated on either path.

id.description: ReliefWeb numeric job ID. Obtained from reliefweb_search_jobs results.

sections.description: Sections of the job record to return, named by the sections[].name values an outline response lists. Omit for the whole record, or for a section outline when the record is over the response budget. Identity metadata — the record's ID, its name, and its canonical URL — comes back alongside whatever is requested. The call is self-contained — the record is re-fetched and sliced, so no prior call has to be repeated.

items.description: A section name exactly as the outline response spelled it.

name: reliefweb_get_job

body.description: Full vacancy description (HTML) — duties, requirements, and conditions.

dateChanged.description: Date this posting was last modified (ISO 8601).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: No job posting found with the given ID. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

howToApply.description: Application instructions (HTML) as published by the hiring organization.

kind.description: full when the record — or the sections asked for — is returned in whole; outline when the record exceeded the response budget and only its section index is returned.

outlineNotice.description: How to re-call this tool for specific sections of the record.

sections.description: Every section of the record, largest first. Pass the names back in `sections` to retrieve them.

items.description: One retrievable section of the record: its name and its serialized size.

bytes.description: Serialized byte size of the section

name.description: Section identifier — pass in `sections` to retrieve it

status.description: Posting status: published while the vacancy is open, expired once it has closed.

types.description: Job type names, such as Job or Consultancy.

url.description: ReliefWeb node URL for this job listing.

urlAlias.description: Canonical ReliefWeb URL for this job listing.

title: Get ReliefWeb Job
